Con

vocabulary.definition: the state of being aware of and able to think about one's surroundings and inner state
vocabulary.example: Studying the different levels of consciousness in animals helps us understand their behaviors better.

vocabulary.definition: based on what one feels to be true even without conscious reasoning
vocabulary.example: She intuited that something was wrong before receiving any confirmation.

vocabulary.definition: extremely complex and difficult to follow
vocabulary.example: The plot of the novel was so convoluted that many readers struggled to understand it.

vocabulary.definition: the way in which something is regarded, understood, or interpreted
vocabulary.example: His perception of the situation differed greatly from hers.

vocabulary.definition: regard as probable; expect or predict
vocabulary.example: She anticipated that the meeting would be canceled due to bad weather.

vocabulary.definition: understand and share the feelings of another
vocabulary.example: He could empathize with her situation, having gone through something similar himself.
